description:
List the task board columns (taskboxes) for a property: id, name, status (todo/in_progress/done) and order. Use a returned taskbox id (or the status keyword) with create_task/update_task to move a task into that column — including the usually-empty DONE column.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// list the task board columns for the property.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com"}
```
name: list_taskboxes
title: Task board columns
